shadowSentences: I love reading books in my free time.
My favorite season is autumn because of the colors.
I often cook new recipes on the weekend.
Traveling to new places brings me joy and excitement.
I enjoy listening to music while I work on projects.
Exercising regularly helps me stay healthy and focused.
I find gardening to be a relaxing and rewarding hobby.
Learning new languages opens up many opportunities for me.
Spending time with family is important for my happiness.
Volunteering at local shelters has taught me the value of community.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: What is the most memorable trip you have taken?
Q2: What challenges did you face while traveling?
Q3: How do you feel about traveling alone versus with friends?
Q4: What tips would you give someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about learning strategies.

Q3: What do you think about group study sessions?
Q4: What advice would you give to students struggling to stay focused?
